A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.es: Un /31 tiene dos direcciones y ambas son utilizables. La RFC 3021 lo permite en enlaces punto a punto, así que no se pierde ninguna dirección de red ni de broadcast.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.pt-BR: Um /31 tem dois endereços e ambos são utilizáveis. A RFC 3021 permite isso em enlaces ponto a ponto, então não há endereço de rede nem de broadcast a sacrificar.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.fr: Un /31 compte deux adresses, toutes deux utilisables. La RFC 3021 l'autorise sur les liaisons point à point : il n'y a donc ni adresse réseau ni adresse de broadcast à sacrifier.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.de: Ein /31 hat zwei Adressen, und beide sind nutzbar. RFC 3021 erlaubt das auf Punkt-zu-Punkt-Verbindungen, sodass weder eine Netz- noch eine Broadcast-Adresse verloren geht.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.id: /31 memiliki dua alamat dan keduanya dapat dipakai. RFC 3021 mengizinkannya pada tautan point-to-point, sehingga tidak ada alamat jaringan atau broadcast yang harus dikorbankan.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.it: Una /31 ha due indirizzi, entrambi utilizzabili. La RFC 3021 lo consente sui collegamenti punto-punto, quindi non si perde un indirizzo di rete né di broadcast.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.tr: Bir /31'de iki adres vardır ve ikisi de kullanılabilir. RFC 3021 bunu noktadan noktaya bağlantılarda mümkün kılar, bu yüzden feda edilecek ağ veya yayın adresi yoktur.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.vi: /31 có hai địa chỉ và cả hai đều dùng được. RFC 3021 cho phép điều này trên liên kết điểm-điểm, nên không phải bỏ địa chỉ mạng hay broadcast.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.ru: У /31 два адреса, и оба доступны. RFC 3021 разрешает это для соединений «точка-точка», поэтому адреса сети и широковещательного адреса не нужны.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.pl: Sieć /31 ma dwa adresy i oba są użyteczne. RFC 3021 dopuszcza to na łączach punkt-punkt, więc nie trzeba rezygnować z adresu sieci ani rozgłoszeniowego.
A /31 has two addresses and both are usa.hi: /31 में दो पते होते हैं और दोनों इस्तेमाल हो सकते हैं। RFC 3021 पॉइंट-टू-पॉइंट लिंक पर इसकी अनुमति देता है, इसलिए नेटवर्क या ब्रॉडकास्ट एड्रेस छोड़ना नहीं पड़ता।

A /32 is a single host: the network, the.pt-BR: Um /32 é um único host: a rede, o primeiro e o último endereço são o mesmo.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.fr: Un /32 est un hôte unique : le réseau, la première et la dernière adresse sont une seule et même adresse.

A /32 is a single host: the network, the.it: Una /32 è un host singolo: la rete, il primo e l'ultimo indirizzo coincidono.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.tr: Bir /32 tek bir ana makinedir: ağ, ilk ve son adres aynı adrestir.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.vi: /32 là một host duy nhất: địa chỉ mạng, địa chỉ đầu tiên và địa chỉ cuối cùng đều là một.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.ru: /32 — это один узел: адрес сети, первый и последний адреса совпадают.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.pl: Sieć /32 to pojedynczy host: adres sieci, pierwszy i ostatni są tym samym adresem.
A /32 is a single host: the network, the.hi: /32 एक अकेला होस्ट है: नेटवर्क, पहला और आखिरी पता, सब एक ही हैं।

A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.pt-BR: Um /0 cobre todo o espaço de endereços IPv4; é o que uma rota padrão abrange.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.fr: Un /0 couvre tout l'espace d'adressage IPv4 ; c'est la plage qu'une route par défaut couvre.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.de: Ein /0 deckt den gesamten IPv4-Adressraum ab; genau diesen Bereich erfasst eine Standardroute.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.id: /0 mencakup seluruh ruang alamat IPv4; inilah yang dicocokkan oleh rute default.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.it: Una /0 copre l'intero spazio di indirizzamento IPv4; è ciò che corrisponde a una route predefinita.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.tr: Bir /0 tüm IPv4 adres uzayını kapsar; varsayılan rotanın eşleştiği budur.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.vi: /0 bao trùm toàn bộ không gian địa chỉ IPv4; đây là thứ mà tuyến mặc định khớp.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.ru: /0 охватывает всё адресное пространство IPv4; именно ему соответствует маршрут по умолчанию.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.pl: Sieć /0 obejmuje całą przestrzeń adresów IPv4; to ją dopasowuje trasa domyślna.
A /0 covers the entire IPv4 address spac.hi: /0 पूरे IPv4 एड्रेस स्पेस को कवर करता है; डिफ़ॉल्ट रूट इसी से मेल खाता है।

IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.es: IPv6 no tiene dirección de broadcast, así que todas las direcciones del rango se pueden asignar. La primera es la dirección anycast del router de la subred, que la mayoría de las redes deja sin usar.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.pt-BR: O IPv6 não tem endereço de broadcast, então todos os endereços da faixa podem ser atribuídos. O primeiro é o endereço anycast do roteador da sub-rede, que a maioria das redes deixa sem uso.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.fr: IPv6 n'a pas d'adresse de broadcast : toutes les adresses de la plage peuvent donc être attribuées. La première est l'adresse anycast du routeur du sous-réseau, que la plupart des réseaux laissent inutilisée.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.de: IPv6 kennt keine Broadcast-Adresse, daher kann jede Adresse im Bereich vergeben werden. Die erste ist die Subnet-Router-Anycast-Adresse, die die meisten Netze ungenutzt lassen.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.id: IPv6 tidak punya alamat broadcast, jadi setiap alamat dalam rentang dapat dialokasikan. Alamat pertama adalah alamat anycast router subnet, yang tidak dipakai di kebanyakan jaringan.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.it: IPv6 non ha un indirizzo di broadcast, quindi ogni indirizzo dell'intervallo può essere assegnato. Il primo è l'indirizzo anycast del subnet-router, che la maggior parte delle reti lascia inutilizzato.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.tr: IPv6'da yayın adresi yoktur, bu yüzden aralıktaki her adres atanabilir. İlki, çoğu ağın kullanmadan bıraktığı subnet-router anycast adresidir.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.vi: IPv6 không có địa chỉ broadcast, nên mọi địa chỉ trong dải đều có thể gán. Địa chỉ đầu tiên là địa chỉ anycast subnet-router, mà hầu hết mạng để trống.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.ru: В IPv6 нет широковещательного адреса, поэтому можно назначать любой адрес диапазона. Первый из них — anycast-адрес маршрутизатора подсети, который в большинстве сетей не используется.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.pl: IPv6 nie ma adresu rozgłoszeniowego, więc każdy adres z zakresu można przydzielić. Pierwszy to adres anycast routera podsieci, którego większość sieci nie używa.
IPv6 has no broadcast address, so every.hi: IPv6 में ब्रॉडकास्ट एड्रेस नहीं होता, इसलिए रेंज का हर पता असाइन किया जा सकता है। पहला पता subnet-router anycast एड्रेस है, जिसे ज़्यादातर नेटवर्क खाली छोड़ते हैं।
